THE PROJECT, IN PRACTICE

What you can do with it.

01

What this repository contains

The reviewed-qa configuration combines retained, repaired, and approved Q&A pairs. Separate provenance records and historical configurations document the dataset’s evolution. Vendor-derived licensing and coverage limits are detailed in the card.

02

Read the schema before training

Inspect the dataset card and viewer to understand fields, split definitions, and how examples were constructed.

03

Preserve the intended target

Use the documented training target and provenance. Cumulative trace datasets generally supervise the final assistant step rather than repeatedly training earlier context.
